time_contract: All decision times use UTC Z. authorized_at must be at or before preparation time. expires_at and delete_by must be strictly after the requested capture interval; delete_by must be no later than 30 days after preparation time.
custody_contract: Custody files are normalized relative paths beginning local-replay-intake/ and are resolved only beneath chat_replay/local-replay-intake.
privacy: The request and output bundle are ignored local custody artifacts. This tool does not discover, contact, or attest any provider permission.
